question_summary: Reinforcement detail for slab-on-deck pour strip conflicts between Structural General Notes S-001 and Foundation Plan S-101, with a follow-up question on whether the resolution applies to all pour strips on the level.
routing_rationale: The RFI concerns a structural document discrepancy without cost-impacting substitution or urgent schedule-driven field conflict, so it routes to the Structural Engineer as design professional of record.
